issues.description: test-install-scripts.yml uses `dnf search python3.12` which can fail the step
issues.detail: `dnf search` returns non-zero (exit 1) when no match is found, and with `set -e` semantics in a shell step that may fail the job on certain images. It's also extraneous noise in CI. Remove the `dnf search` line; rely on `dnf install` to fail loudly if the package is unavailable.

issues.description: Amazon Linux step no longer pins a Python version package consistent with Rocky
issues.detail: Previously Amazon Linux only installed `git`, relying on the system Python. The new step installs `python3.12` via dnf, which may not exist on Amazon Linux 2 (only AL2023 ships 3.12). If the runner uses AL2, the install will fail. Verify the AL image variant or guard the version.

issues.description: install.sh version check still allows Python 3.7-3.9 despite README requiring 3.10+
issues.detail: The guard `PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7` permits 3.7, 3.8, 3.9 to pass, contradicting the updated error message and pyproject `requires-python = '>=3.10'`. Change `-lt 7` to `-lt 10` so the check matches the new minimum and users get the correct rejection.

issues.description: Stale `default_raise` comment references < 3.10 compatibility that no longer exists
issues.detail: `default_raise` in wallet_request_types.py retains the comment 'this is for < 3.10 compatibility' (around line 1227 area) even though all callers now use native `kw_only=True`. The helper may still be needed for `default_factory`, but the rationale comment is misleading post-cleanup.

issues.description: Ruff `UP007/UP035/UP045` ignores added without a tracking issue or owner
issues.detail: The TODO 'Remove these - it's a lot of errors' silently disables the modernization rules the PR description claims to enforce. Without an issue link or ratchet, these are likely to remain forever. File a tracking issue and reference it in the comment, or land a follow-up before merge.

issues.description: `option()` default handling subtly changes for callers that didn't pass `default`
issues.detail: Previously on <3.10 the default was `None`; now `MISSING` is always used. Combined with `kw_only=True`, any `option()` field without an explicit default becomes required. Confirm no existing call site relied on the implicit-None behavior under 3.9 that now becomes a required kwarg under 3.10+.

review.summary: The PR cleanly drops Python 3.9, removes version-guarded dataclass shims, and updates CI matrices and install scripts. Main concerns: install.sh's minimum-version guard still says 3.7 (contradicting README/pyproject), the Amazon Linux/Rocky steps add a noisy `dnf search` that can fail and assume python3.12 availability on AL2/Rocky images, and the ruff modernization ignores (UP007/UP035/UP045) are added with only a TODO. The dataclass cleanup in cmd_classes.py also slightly changes default semantics for `option()` without a documented migration.
